title: Seattle Sounders 2-1 Sporting Kansas City: Roldan grabs last-gasp winner
subtitle: Cristian Roldan scored in the 90th minute to propel the Seattle Sounders to a 2-1 victory over Sporting Kansas City.
paragraphs: The Seattle Sounders made it three straight MLS wins as their surge up the Western Conference continued with a last-gasp 2-1 victory over Sporting Kansas City.
Cristian Roldan grabbed the decisive goal at Lumen Field for the Sounders, who sit seventh in the West and are unbeaten in eight games.

SKC goalkeeper Stefan Cleveland was busy early on when he denied Peter Kingston, tipping a long-range attempt over the crossbar, before the visitors went close through Calvin Harris, who forced Alex Roldan into a goal-line clearance.

A flurry of SKC chances followed, and they eventually broke the deadlock when Andre Luiz struck on the cusp of half-time, just after Seattle's Andrew Thomas had made a sprawling save to keep out Stephen Afrifa's attempt.
Yet Seattle drew level just six minutes after the restart, with substitute Sebastian Gomez capitalising on Jordan Morris' fantastic work in the build-up.
Caden Clark went close to nudging the Sounders ahead, but Thomas was called upon to thwart Taylor Calheira at the other end.
That save paved the way for Cristian Roldan to come up with the goods in the 90th minute, as he pounced on a defensive mix-up to clinch all three points.
This is the first time since May that Seattle have won an MLS game that they were trailing at half-time.
And after a 13-match winless streak, it is now three victories on the spin for the Sounders, who are looking good for a playoff place.

Seattle are now unbeaten in five straight matches against SKC (W4 D1). The Sounders managed to avoid defeat only three times in their previous ten games against Kansas City (W3 L7), dating back to 2019.
Sporting, who sit bottom of the West, may consider themselves unfortunate, though, considering they had the better chances, creating opportunities worth a combined 2.05 expected goals to 1.7 xG.
Luiz was in the thick of the action again for SKC.

He has been involved in three goals in his last two appearances, after becoming the first player to record a goal and an assist in a regular-season away match for Sporting since Dejan Joveljic against LA Galaxy in March, when he netted and laid one up against the Houston Dynamo in SKC's previous outing.
